title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - EntityCategory
description: The (entity) category resource is used to group entity catalog items in logical containers. Categories can contain other categories. Resource IDs for categories are strings and are defined by the catalog application. (TM Forum TMF662 Entity Catalog Management 4.0.0, Swagger definition EntityCategory; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:EntityCategory:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'EntityCategory'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/EntityCategory/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:EntityCategory:<tmfId>. unique identifier

isRoot.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/EntityCategory/properties/isRoot'. If true, this Boolean indicates that the category is a root of categories

lastUpdate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/EntityCategory/properties/lastUpdate'. Date and time of the last update

lifecycleStatus.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/EntityCategory/properties/lifecycleStatus'. Used to indicate the current lifecycle status

parentId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/EntityCategory/properties/parentId'. Unique identifier of the parent category

childCategory.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/EntityCategory/properties/childCategory'. The child category(ies) if any, contained in this category. In TMF this is an array of EntityCategoryRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced EntityCategory entities (urn:ngsi-ld:EntityCategory:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

entityCatalogItem.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/EntityCategory/properties/entityCatalogItem'. The catalog items referred to by this category. In TMF this is an array of EntityCatalogItemRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced EntityCatalogItem entities (urn:ngsi-ld:EntityCatalogItem:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

validFor.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/EntityCategory/properties/validFor'. The period for which the category is valid

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/EntityCategory/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/EntityCategory/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/EntityCategory/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'EntityCategory' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

TimePeriod.description: A period of time, either as a deadline (endDateTime only) a startDateTime only, or both

endDateTime.description: End of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format

startDateTime.description: Start of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format
